name: XDKNet
description: XDKNet brings a modern TV-style UI to Jellyfin web, with a custom navbar, a featured media bar, Seerr integration, and cross-device settings synchronization.
overview: Custom UI and settings sync for Jellyfin

Adds a Storage tab to the plugin settings page: what every library, resolution and title is costing on disk, free space per drive, charts, and the ability to delete oversized or never-watched media - files and all - straight from the page.
Adds an XDKNet log, viewable under Help on the plugin settings page. The settings page records its own failures there, so problems like the empty user dropdowns can be diagnosed from the server.
Fixes empty user dropdowns on Jellyfin 10.11, where the user list moved and the dashboard could no longer read it. The plugin now supplies the list itself.
Fixes the empty user dropdowns on the plugin settings page, which also stopped the existing apply-to-a-single-user list from loading.

Admin tools for setting users up without touching their TV. Import your own settings into the user defaults instead of retyping them, push those defaults to one user, copy one user's setup onto another, and sign a user in to Seerr from the dashboard. A table shows who is set up. Seerr keys are never copied between accounts, so nobody requests through someone else's. The character avatar set can also be imported into the plugin from the settings page now.

Profile pictures can now come from your own server. Characters lists an avatar set stored by the plugin itself, People and Posters pull actor headshots and artwork straight from your library, and the generated faces are still there with the abstract patterns dropped. Admins can import an existing avatar set into the plugin so it no longer depends on another plugin staying installed.

Profile pictures. Pick an avatar from a generated grid or upload a photo, and it becomes your real Jellyfin profile image, so it shows in the XDKNet web app, on Android TV, in Jellyfin's own web UI and in every other client. Reachable from Account & Security, from settings search, and by selecting your own card in the account switcher. Fully navigable with a TV remote. The server renders the picture so the flow is identical on a TV, and admins can switch generation off in the plugin settings.
The button that opens the XDKNet web view from Jellyfin's header now shows the XDKNet logo instead of the old Moonfin one.

Fixes the watch-history import failing with 'no users found' on Jellyfin 10.11, where the user list API changed from properties to methods. The map now has zoom controls, a fit-to-viewers button, and selectable basemaps (Slate, Midnight, Light, Streets, Terrain).

Fixes 'no users found' when importing watch history (the user list is now read correctly on every server version), and the import runs in the background so a large library cannot time it out. Viewer Locations is now a real map. Adds Reclaim Space (biggest titles nobody has played) and Year in Review.

Import your existing watch history: rebuilds statistics from the play counts Jellyfin has tracked all along, so charts and top-lists cover the life of the server. Adds an opt-in Viewer Locations map showing where remote streams come from, with alerts when one account streams from two places at once. Local network addresses are never sent anywhere.

Fixes the library health scan failing on Jellyfin 10.11 (BaseItem.GetMediaStreams was removed). Now Streaming shows the real bitrate for direct-play streams plus elapsed/total time and how long is left. Admin sidebar restyled to match the dashboard.

Fixes the redesigned dashboard not appearing after an update. Flutter's main.dart.wasm/main.dart.js keep the same filename in every build and were served without cache headers, so browsers and proxies kept running the old app code. Every web asset now revalidates (304s keep it fast).

Fixes plugin updates not taking effect: the web app no longer registers a service worker (which was caching the old build and surviving browser cache clears) and unregisters any stale one on load. Also restores the admin dashboard's card borders and elevation on Apple devices.

Admin dashboard now renders the XDKNet design on every theme (bordered, elevated cards; iOS-style KPI tiles with usage ring), and the web app is served no-cache so future plugin updates take effect without clearing your browser.
Branding fix: XDKNet login/startup logo replaces the old Moonfin wordmark, and the leftover "Moonbase" plugin name is renamed to "XDKNet" throughout the UI.

Redesigned iOS-style server admin dashboard: live Now Streaming with terminate/message controls, play-history + top-users + bandwidth analytics, searchable watch history, notification routing (Discord/Telegram/ntfy), and library-health checks.
Config page loads its script as an external file so it runs under strict Content-Security-Policy - fixes dead tabs (Seerr, Games, etc.) in some browsers/proxies.
Config tabs switch via a delegated capture-phase handler so they work on the iOS/mobile Jellyfin dashboard.
Fix plugin config tabs not switching on the mobile Jellyfin dashboard (config page now self-initializes).
Bundled the XDKNet web app (served at /XDKNet/Web/). Fixes the 'web root not found' error from the earlier server-only build.
Bundled the XDKNet web app (served at /XDKNet/Web/).
